elevation_mean_m.name: elevation_mean_m
elevation_mean_m.description: Mean digital elevation above sea level within 1-km cell
elevation_mean_m.source_dataset: SRTM GL1 30m DEM (European Space Agency STEP Archive)
elevation_mean_m.missing_value_policy: Filtered NoData (-32768); NaN if no valid pixels
elevation_mean_m.scientific_limitations: C-band radar surface elevation; does not represent bare-earth DTM or urban micro-gutters.

elevation_min_m.name: elevation_min_m
elevation_min_m.scientific_limitations: Lowest observed surface point; subject to radar speckle and tree canopy tops.

elevation_max_m.name: elevation_max_m
elevation_max_m.scientific_limitations: Captures local ridge or building crests.

elevation_std_m.name: elevation_std_m
elevation_std_m.scientific_limitations: Flat areas (< 3m std) indicate potential ponding plains; does not resolve curb drainage.

built_up_fraction.name: built_up_fraction
built_up_fraction.description: Fraction of cell area classified as built-up structures and sealed surfaces
built_up_fraction.scientific_limitations: Represents optical/SAR classified built-up land cover; not measured continuous imperviousness percentage.

water_fraction.name: water_fraction
water_fraction.description: Fraction of cell area classified as permanent or perennial open water bodies
water_fraction.scientific_limitations: Static 2021 annual permanent water; does not capture seasonal tank shrinkage or pre-monsoon drybeds.

tree_cover_fraction.name: tree_cover_fraction
tree_cover_fraction.description: Fraction of cell area classified as tree canopy cover
tree_cover_fraction.scientific_limitations: High canopy interception in urban parks and peri-urban forests.

cropland_fraction.name: cropland_fraction
cropland_fraction.description: Fraction of cell area classified as cultivated agricultural land
cropland_fraction.scientific_limitations: Agricultural bunds retain water; tilled soils exhibit seasonal infiltration changes.

upa_mean_sqkm.name: upa_mean_sqkm
upa_mean_sqkm.description: Mean upstream catchment contributing area draining through cell
upa_mean_sqkm.scientific_limitations: Blocked pending manual user registration at Yamazaki Lab Google Form. Do not substitute zeros.

rainfall_daily_depth_mm.name: rainfall_daily_depth_mm
rainfall_daily_depth_mm.source_dataset: NASA GPM IMERG Final Daily Run (GPM_3IMERGDF)
rainfall_daily_depth_mm.missing_value_policy: NaN if granule missing; nonnegative physical bounds
rainfall_daily_depth_mm.scientific_limitations: Coarse satellite microwave-IR blend. Does not resolve localized convective thunderstorm micro-cells.

precip_antecedent_3d_mm.name: precip_antecedent_3d_mm
precip_antecedent_3d_mm.description: Cumulative precipitation strictly prior to current date over 3-day lookback
precip_antecedent_3d_mm.aggregation_method: Rolling sum shifted by 1 day (strictly prior)
precip_antecedent_3d_mm.missing_value_policy: Requires full prior lookback; NaN if lookback incomplete

precip_antecedent_7d_mm.name: precip_antecedent_7d_mm
precip_antecedent_7d_mm.description: Cumulative precipitation strictly prior to current date over 7-day lookback

precip_api_decay_mm.name: precip_api_decay_mm
precip_api_decay_mm.description: Antecedent Precipitation Index with daily depletion decay (alpha=0.85, 14-day window)
precip_api_decay_mm.aggregation_method: Sum of prior P_{t-k} * (0.85)^k for k=1..14
precip_api_decay_mm.scientific_limitations: Hydrological proxy for soil moisture depletion; not direct in-situ TDR soil moisture sensor data.

sar_candidate_flood_pct.name: sar_candidate_flood_pct
sar_candidate_flood_pct.description: Percentage of cell area classified as candidate specular flood change in simulation fixture
sar_candidate_flood_pct.aggregation_method: Polygon masked pixel count / total valid pixels
sar_candidate_flood_pct.missing_value_policy: STRICTLY EXCLUDED FROM REAL OBSERVATIONAL MATRIX
sar_candidate_flood_pct.scientific_limitations: Raw Sentinel-1A SAFE archives were not downloaded; values are simulation fixtures and must not enter ML models.

has_reported_incident_on_date.name: has_reported_incident_on_date
has_reported_incident_on_date.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a verified Group A or B flood incident occurred in this cell on this date
has_reported_incident_on_date.missing_value_policy: False = NO REPORTED INCIDENT (Never assume verified absence of flood)
has_reported_incident_on_date.scientific_limitations: Subject to media and urban reporting bias (concentrated in tech corridor gated layouts). Unreported cells are unlabelled.
